costOwnership.province: destination-level costs only: travel-to-destination, lodging, food, local transport; never child POI tickets or child-specific prices
costOwnership.county: county-level travel/lodging/food/local transport costs; never child POI costs
costOwnership.city: city-level travel/lodging/food/local transport costs; never child POI costs
costOwnership.village: village-owned costs and actual village entry/onsite services only
costOwnership.place: costs that occur at this exact place: entry, parking, guide, equipment, onsite services

policy.faqOwnership: FAQ questions must be about the current entity. A parent may not use child-specific ticket, opening-hours, facility, or direction questions.
policy.checklist: travelChecklist is independent per entity. Use only concrete short packing/checking items relevant to that entity and selected travel mode; never store prose, advice, distances or child information. Common items may repeat, but the checklist must not be copied wholesale from a parent.
policy.media: Each entity owns 5 images for province/county/city/place and 3 for village/camping. The same image URL may not be used by two entities. Parent/child/sibling-only images are forbidden. Thumbnail counts toward the target.
